series.name: MSG lamp troubleshooting (cooling/heat pump)
series.notes: MSG Service Manual §12.2 lamp troubleshooting (5 Hz flashes) — model-scoped lamp table.

title.en: Indoor fan speed out of control over 1 minute
title.ur: Indoor fan speed control se bahar, 1 minute se zyada

meaning.en: MSG-series troubleshooting table reports this lamp combination as the fault indicator.
meaning.ur: MSG series ki troubleshooting table ke mutabiq yeh lamp combination kharabi ka indicator hai

causes.en: Failure condition listed in the MSG service-manual lamp table.
causes.ur: MSG service manual ki lamp table mein likhi hui failure condition

causes.en: Applies to the on/off MSG split family (07–21 class and heat-pump variants).
causes.ur: Yeh on/off MSG split family (07–21 class aur heat pump variants) par laagu hai

solutions.en: Power-cycle; if the pattern persists, follow the service-manual diagnostic chart.
solutions.ur: Power cycle karein; agar nishan barqarar rahe to service manual ke diagnostic chart par amal karein.

solutions.en: Check the corresponding sensor, fan wiring, or EEPROM/board as titled.
solutions.ur: Title ke mutabiq sensor, fan wiring ya EEPROM/board check karein

notes.en: Scope: MSG conventional split service-manual section 12.2 (cooling vs heat-pump lamp maps).
notes.ur: Yeh entries MSG conventional split ke service-manual section 12.2 se hain (cooling aur heat-pump ke lamp maps).
